meta.title: ミュートユーザーリストのページネーション機能を実装
meta.body_summary: Implement PushableListView pagination for the muted users list so the load-more button appears and initial loading is improved for many muted users; linked to issue #777.

perf_labels.notes: No review or comment text is available; the small pagination PR remained unreviewed for over a year and was closed, so outcome is inferred as stale/abandoned rather than explicit technical rejection.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 96 changed lines across 3 files, this is a small pagination-focused edit by absolute volume. The closed outcome is not explained by change size; instead, the PR received no review or comment text and was closed after more than a year, consistent with stale/abandoned agent PR.

review_details.concern_detail: The dataset contains no formal reviews, PR comments, or inline review comments. The PR was created on 2025-07-07 and closed on 2026-08-05; with no maintainer reaction, the most plausible closure reason is stale inactivity rather than an explicit technical rejection.
review_details.performance_claim: PushableListView pagination shows the load more button and improves initial load time for large muted-user lists by fetching pages via mute/list untilId.
review_details.rejection_signals: No review or rejection text available; closure is inferred as stale/abandoned due to absence of engagement and the >1-year lifespan.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot completed a small Flutter pagination refactor following existing PushableListView patterns and linked the issue, but the PR received no review or feedback and was eventually closed without merge. This illustrates a process boundary where lack of maintainer engagement, not technical failure, determines outcome.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body provides code snippets and API support claims but no benchmark, timings, profiler, or reproducible test instructions; no review text offers verification.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No review issues were raised in the available data. The PR was closed without merge after an extremely long inactive period; no fix cycle or revert occurred.

core_change_summary.description: In muted_users_page.dart, Copilot replaced the all-at-once ListView.builder with PushableListView<Muting>, using initializeFuture to load the first page from the misskey mute/list endpoint and nextFuture to fetch subsequent pages via MuteListRequest(untilId: lastItem.id). The muted-users state notifier was updated for pagination, and the widget test was adjusted.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Only four new lines in the test file; no CI result or review text was available to validate behavior.
